1.name: Item Movement
1.description: Civil ability bonus for moving items.

2.name: Item Creation
2.description: Civil ability bonus for crafting items.

3.name: Flanking
3.description: Bonus when attacking from flanking position.

4.name: Opportunist
4.description: Gives you the ability to perform attacks of opportunity.

5.name: Backstabber
5.description: Deal increased damage when attacking from behind.

6.name: Barter
6.description: Civil ability for better trading prices.

9.name: Parry Master
9.description: Gives you a 10% bonus dodge chance while dual wielding.

17.name: Duck Duck Goose
17.description: Lets you evade attacks of opportunity. Requires Huntsman 1.

21.name: Resist Death
21.description: Resistance to Death Wish and similar effects.

25.name: Picture of Health
25.description: Grants +3% extra Vitality for every point of Warfare. Requires Warfare 1.

26.name: Bigger and Better
26.description: Immediately grants 2 extra attribute points. Requires Level 2.

27.name: All Skilled Up
27.description: Grants 1 additional Combat Ability Point and 1 extra Civil Ability Point. Requires Level 2.

35.name: Charm
35.description: Civil ability for persuasion in dialogue.

38.name: Lucky Charm
38.description: Chance to find extra loot in containers.

41.name: Guerilla
41.description: While sneaking, your attack damage is increased by 40%. Reduces the AP cost of sneaking in combat by 1 AP. Requires Sneaking 1.

42.name: Pet Pal
42.description: Enables you to talk to animals.

43.name: Escapist
43.description: Allows you to flee combat even when enemies are right next to you.

44.name: Comeback Kid
44.description: Once per combat, if an enemy lands a fatal blow, you bounce back to life with 20% health.

45.name: The Pawn
45.description: Permits your character 1 AP worth of free movement per turn. Does not work with Executioner. Requires Scoundrel 1.

46.name: Light Step
46.description: Reduces damage from surfaces and traps.

47.name: Morning Person
47.description: When resurrected, you resurrect to full health.

50.name: All Skilled Up
50.description: Grants 1 additional Combat Ability Point and 1 extra Civil Ability Point. Requires Level 2.

51.name: What a Rush
51.description: Increases your recovery and maximum Action Points by 1 when your health is below 50%.

52.name: Far Out Man
52.description: Increase the range of spells and scrolls by 2m. Does not affect melee and touch-ranged skills.

53.name: Leech
53.description: Heals you when standing in blood.

54.name: Elemental Affinity
54.description: Lowers the Action Point cost of spells by 1 when standing in a surface of the same element.

55.name: Five-Star Diner
55.description: Doubles the effects of foods and potions.

56.name: Bully
56.description: Deal more damage to targets with lower Physical or Magic Armour.

57.name: Elemental Ranger
57.description: Arrows will deal bonus elemental damage depending on the surface the target is standing in. Requires Huntsman 1.

58.name: Lightning Rod
58.description: Bonus when standing in electrified surfaces.

61.name: Lone Wolf
61.description: Provides +2 Max AP, +2 Recovery AP, +30% Vitality, +60% Physical Armour, +60% Magic Armour when solo or with at most one companion. Incompatible with Glass Cannon.

62.name: Zombie
62.description: Lets you heal from poison, but regular healing will damage you instead. Undead race.

63.name: Demon
63.description: Gain 15% fire resistance and 15% water weakness. Max fire resistance also increases by 10. Cannot be used with Ice King. Requires Pyrokinetic 1.

64.name: Ice King
64.description: Grants +15% Water resistance and +15% fire weakness. Max water resistance is raised by 10. Cannot work with Demon. Requires Hydrosophist 1.

65.name: Hothead
65.description: While you are at maximum Vitality, grants you an extra 10% critical chance and 10% more accuracy.

67.name: Walk It Off
67.description: Reduces all status durations by 1 turn. This also affects positive statuses.

68.name: Folk Dancer
68.description: Bonus to movement and dance-related effects.

70.name: Stench
70.description: Decreases everyone's attitude towards you by 25, but melee combatants will find you less attractive.

71.name: Kickstarter
71.description: Bonus at the start of combat.

75.name: Ranger: Arrow Recovery
75.description: Grants a 33% chance to recover a special arrow after firing it.

76.name: Ranger: Duck Duck Goose
76.description: Lets you evade attacks of opportunity. Requires Huntsman 1.

77.name: Ranger: Ranged AP Bonus
77.description: Ranger bonus to ranged Action Points.

79.name: Rogue: Backstabber
79.description: Deal increased damage when attacking from behind.

80.name: Rogue: The Pawn
80.description: 1 AP worth of free movement per turn. Requires Scoundrel 1.

81.name: Rogue: Escapist
81.description: Allows you to flee combat. Requires Scoundrel.

82.name: No Opportunist
82.description: You cannot perform attacks of opportunity.

83.name: Warrior: Grenade Range
83.description: Adds an extra 5m range to your grenade throws.

86.name: Parry Master
86.description: Gives you a 10% bonus dodge chance while dual wielding.

87.name: Human: Ingenious
87.description: Gives you 5% bonus Critical Chance and 10% extra Critical Multiplier. Human race.

89.name: Elf: Ancestral Knowledge
89.description: Gives you +1 to Loremaster. Elf race.

90.name: Elf: Corpse Eater
90.description: Lets you eat body parts to access the memory of the dead. Elf race.

91.name: Dwarf: Sturdy
91.description: Gives you +10% max Vitality and +5% Dodging. Dwarf race.

92.name: Dwarf: Dwarven Guile
92.description: Gives you +1 in Sneaking. Dwarf race.

93.name: Lizard: Resistance
93.description: Gives you +10% Fire Resistance and +10% Poison Resistance. Lizard race.

94.name: Lizard: Sophisticated
94.description: Gives you +1 to Persuasion. Lizard race.

95.name: Perfectionist
95.description: Bonus when at full health and armour.

96.name: Executioner
96.description: Gain 2 AP after dealing a killing blow (once per turn). Does not work with The Pawn. Requires Warfare 1.

97.name: Savage Sortilege
97.description: Gives all magical skills a critical chance equal to your critical chance score.

99.name: Quest: Spider's Kiss Strength
99.description: Spider's Kiss gives you -2 CON and +2 Strength. From A Web of Desire quest.

100.name: Quest: Spider's Kiss Intelligence
100.description: Spider's Kiss gives you -2 CON and +2 Intelligence. From A Web of Desire quest.

101.name: Quest: Spider's Kiss Perception
101.description: Spider's Kiss gives you -2 CON and +2 Wits. From A Web of Desire quest.

102.name: Quest: Spider's Kiss Null
102.description: Spider's Kiss variant. From A Web of Desire quest.

103.name: Mnemonic
103.description: Gives you 3 extra points in your Memory attribute. From Sebille's Mother Tree quest.

104.name: Quest: Trader's Secrets
104.description: Gives +1 Bartering from eating Garvan's head. From Aggressive Takeover quest.

106.name: Beast Master
106.description: Bonus to summoning and animal companions.

107.name: Living Armour
107.description: 35% of all healing you receive is added to your Magic Armour.

108.name: Torturer
108.description: Certain statuses caused by you are no longer blocked by Magic or Physical Armour, and their duration is extended by one turn. Affects Burning, Poisoned, Bleeding, Necrofire, Acid, Suffocating, Entangled, Death Wish, and Ruptured Tendons.

109.name: Ambidextrous
109.description: Reduces the cost of using grenades and scrolls by 1 AP if your offhand is free.

110.name: Unstable
110.description: You explode upon death, dealing 50% of your vitality as physical damage in a 3 meter radius.

112.name: Natural Conductor
112.description: Bonus when standing in electrified surfaces.

113.name: Quest: Rooted
113.description: Quest reward. Gives bonus when standing in nature surfaces.
